intro: Trying to find Washington scholarships that consider financial need and stay on the lower-award side usually means sorting through a lot of mixed results. This filtered USA view narrows that search to a focused set of listings so you can compare options with less noise. The programs below span areas such as education, community, STEM, medicine, disability, and other subjects, with study levels that can include high school seniors, college students, graduate students, and adult learners. Awards vary by listing, and so do deadlines, residency or citizenship details, essay expectations, and other requirement lines. Some entries may be relatively straightforward to apply for, but every scholarship should still be checked on the official source before you move forward.

faq.question: Can I apply to every scholarship listed on this page if I live in the USA?
faq.answer: Not automatically. Many rows in this USA-focused slice may also have their own residency, study level, or citizenship rules, so check each listing’s official page before you apply.

faq.question: What should I compare before I apply?
faq.answer: Compare the award amount, deadline, study level, category, and any essay or document requirements shown in the catalog. This page includes a focused set of listings where deadlines differ by program, and some dates appear soon, so it helps to check rows promptly.
